# AI利用OKの公募・コンテスト・ハッカソンまとめ
> 生成AIの利用が認められている（または要項で禁止されていない）、参加無料・日本在住の個人が応募できる賞金付き公募を締切順にまとめた日本語の一覧です。各項目は公式要項へのリンク付きで、更新日はページ内に記載しています。

- [FAQPage 構造化データ作成＆AI引用向け点検](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/faq-jsonld.html): Client-side FAQPage JSON-LD + visible details/summary HTML from Q|A pairs (or Markdown/alternate lines); flags answer-first failures (demonstratives, vague words, missing numbers for how-much/when questions, length); CSV; no upload. Distinct from tenpo-jsonld / ec-toiawase / ai-inyou-check / aeo-guide-check.
- [モール商品タイトル・箇条書き・説明 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/mall-title-check.html): Client-side Amazon.jp / Rakuten / Yahoo Shopping title+bullets+description preflight — per-mall length/byte guide, decorative symbols, promo/superlative phrases, keyword stuffing, missing specs, placeholders; CSV; no upload. Distinct from furima-check / gmc-feed-check / catalog-check.
- [LP・キャンペーンページ ワイヤー／文案 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/lp-wire-check.html): Client-side LP/campaign wire+copy preflight — hero length/audience, offer price/period, benefits count, CTA verbs, trust/social proof, FAQ, contact/hours, tokusho/privacy hints, placeholders, desu/dearu mix, absolute claims; CSV; no upload.
- [UI翻訳 はみ出し・プレースホルダ チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/locale-overflow-check.html): Client-side UI string-freeze LQA — paste CSV/JSON/PO source+translation; flags JA/ZH width overflow (fullwidth≈2), missing `{0}`/`%s`/`{{name}}`/ICU plural placeholders, leading/trailing whitespace, ellipsis/punctuation drift, empty translations, duplicate keys; CSV; no upload.
- [UI翻訳 はみ出し・プレースホルダ チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/locale-overflow-check.html): Client-side UI string-freeze LQA — paste CSV/JSON/PO source+translation; flags JA/ZH width overflow (fullwidth≈2), missing `{0}`/`%s`/`{{name}}`/ICU plural placeholders, leading/trailing whitespace, ellipsis/punctuation drift, empty translations, duplicate keys; CSV; no upload.
- [ゴースト執筆・声の一貫性チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ghost-voice-check.html): Client-side ghostwriting voice-consistency preflight for note/blog/LinkedIn-style drafts — first-person drift, desu/dearu mix, AI stock phrases, hook/CTA, length bands, stock-phrase reuse vs samples, EN/JA mix, placeholders; CSV; no upload.
- [調査レポート・データコンペ写 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/writeup-check.html): Client-side preflight for market-research briefs and Kaggle/Zindi write-ups — missing as-of dates, unsourced numbers, method/limitations gaps, placeholder URLs, vague claims, reproducibility hints; brief vs write-up modes; CSV; no upload.
- [AI音楽・映像 権利＆開示 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ai-rights-check.html): Preflight for AI music/video publish or client delivery — Suno/Udio plan commercial use, voice-clone/likeness/logo flags, stock licence, Content ID promise traps, festival AI-disclosure draft JA/EN + CSV; client-side only; not legal advice.
- [暗号資産 受取アドレス＆ネットワーク照合チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/payout-address-check.html): Check payout address vs stated network (EVM 0x / Solana base58 / NEAR / BCH CashAddr); flags cross-chain paste mistakes; CSV; client-side only; not a wallet.
- [Steam Deck / Steam Machine Verified 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/steam-deck-check.html): Self-checklist for Valve Deck/Machine compatibility (controller, glyphs, text input, default 30fps, resolution, font px, launcher); CSV export; client-side only; not official.
- [Yahoo!プレイス終了対応チェックリスト](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yahoo-place-check.html): Interactive JP shop checklist for Yahoo! Place shutdown (new applications end ~2026-11-30 noon JST; service ends 2027-03-31). Branches by unregistered / registered / reservation-manager; NAP compare Yahoo vs GBP vs site; action memo + CSV; client-side only.
- [プライバシーポリシー・外部送信規律 記載項目チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/privacy-check.html): Paste a JP privacy policy / cookie notice; checks PPC-style disclosure items and Telecom Business Act external-transmission triad (what / to whom / purpose); flags common trackers; CSV export; client-side only; not legal advice.
- [医療費控除・セルフメディケーション税制 概算チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/iryohi-kojo.html): Rough medical-expense deduction (NTA No.1120: paid − insurance − ¥100k or 5% of total income if under ¥2M, max ¥2M) vs self-medication tax (No.1129: OTC above ¥12k, max ¥88k). CSV meisai paste; client-side only; not tax advice.
- [Google Merchant Center／無料リスティング 商品データ否認理由セルフチェック](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/gmc-feed-check.html): 必須属性の抜け、識別子（gtin または mpn+brand）、価格の ISO 通貨、プロモタイトル、重複 id など否認につながりやすいパターンをブラウザ内で点検。Shopify CSV 向け catalog-check とは別。
- [AIエージェント向けショップ情報 公開前チェック＆ナレッジ文作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/agent-kb-check.html): Shopify Sales channels > Agentic Knowledge base（旧アプリは2027-01-15終了）向けに、返品・配送・ギフト・支払い・連絡先・年末年始ルールの抜けを確認し、公開用MarkdownとChatGPT/Gemini用テスト質問を作成。BASE/STORESのFAQにも流用可。ブラウザ内処理。
- [一覧ページ](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/): 締切、賞金、AI利用条件、応募方法の表
- [Steam カプセル画像・スクリーンショット サイズチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/steam-assets.html)
- [薬機法・広告表現チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yakki-check.html)
- [特定商取引法に基づく表記 記載項目チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/tokusho-check.html)
- [ステマ規制 PR表記チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/stema-check.html)
- [字幕ファイル（SRT/VTT）チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/jimaku-check.html): YouTube・講座動画の字幕の読む速さ（文字/秒）、1行の文字数、行数、表示時間、重なり、番号崩れを確認し、タイミングの一括ずらしとSRT⇔VTT変換
- [MTPE単価の時給換算チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/mtpe-calc.html): 機械翻訳ポストエディットの「通常単価の○%」を、処理速度・マッチ率の割引表・チェック時間から実質時給に直し、今の時給を保つ処理速度と最低の割合を出す。
- [小説コンテスト 企画書・あらすじチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kikakusho-check.html): タイトル・キャッチコピー・あらすじの文字数、結末を伏せたあらすじ、固有名詞の多さ、主人公の登場位置を応募前に確認
- [ゲーム不具合報告書（バグレポート）チェッカー＆日英整形](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/bug-report.html)
- [x402 エンドポイント公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/x402-check.html): Preflight for publishing an x402 paid API: discovery chicken-egg (first settled payment vs free trial), /.well-known/x402.json, llms.txt, OpenAPI, 402 body fields, USDC pin, short auth expiry, price band, CSV; client-side only.
- [Steam AI開示・コンテンツディスクリプタ 公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/steam-ai-check.html): Next Fest / store launch preflight for Steam AI content disclosure + content descriptors vs demo/trailer claims; touchpoint inventory, mismatch flags, answer draft, CSV; no upload.
- [全銀フォーマット 総合振込データ作成・チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/zengin-sogo.html): Client-side Zengin (JBA) bulk transfer file builder (type code 21, 120-byte fixed records, Shift_JIS half-width kana, header/data/trailer/end) from CSV/Excel paste; payee-name kana conversion with corporate abbreviations, invalid-char/length/amount/duplicate checks, CSV report.
- [データセット販売・公開前チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/dataset-sell-check.html): Client-side pre-flight for publishing/selling datasets — rights/consent/licence/PII, sample-vs-full, Hugging Face shop-window warning (public Hub files ≈ perpetual free download; keep paid full sets off-platform), README/licence card draft + CSV report.
- [公募応募文 文字数・禁則チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/oubo-entry-check.html): Pre-submit contest entry checker — title/body length limits (with/without whitespace), built-in banned phrases (gen-AI names, rights assignment, prior publication), personal-info leak scan (name/email/phone/postal/SNS), custom banned words, CSV export; client-side only. Distinct from moji-count (manuscript paper) and kikakusho-check (synopsis).
- [AI映画・音楽フェス 応募前チェッカー＆プロセス文下書き](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ai-fest-check.html): Offline preflight for free AI film/music festivals (Cue Xmas ’26, Flick AI, AICF, AI ZONE, custom): runtime, aspect, EN subs, multi-shot/human edit, Christmas theme, Flick watermark post, process word count 200–500; JA+EN process/creative-brief draft + CSV; client-side only.
- [フリーランス募集文チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/boshu-check.html): 業務委託の募集文がフリーランス法12条の必須6項目（名称・住所・連絡先・業務内容・場所・報酬）を満たすか、掲載日の有無、闇バイトによくある表現を確認し、募集文ひな形を作成
- [飲食料品 消費税1%対応チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shokuhin-1pct.html): 令和9年4月〜の飲食料品1%（法案段階）に向けた価格表の一括換算、経過措置8%判定、税率混在の請求書の端数処理、免税事業者の還付目安
- [自動採点つき小テスト作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kotae-quiz.html): 1行1問の問題と答えから、ブラウザ内で採点される単体HTMLの小テストを作成（記述・選択、別解、表記ゆれ許容、解き直し、送信なし）
- [ネットショップ問い合わせ 返信テンプレ＆AIチャット用FAQ作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ec-toiawase.html)
- [Google口コミ返信 下書きチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kuchikomi-henshin.html)
- [内容証明 字数・行数チェック＆謄本レイアウト・料金計算](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/naiyo-shomei.html)
- [翻訳調・AI翻訳っぽさチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/honyakucho-check.html): flags translationese patterns in Japanese machine/AI translation output with rewrite suggestions (client-side).
- [やさしい日本語チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yasashii-check.html): 外国人住民向けお知らせのやさしい日本語を点検（一文の長さ、敬語、二重否定、あいまい表現、ふりがなが必要な漢字、曜日なしの日付、元の文との日付・時刻・金額・電話番号の突き合わせ。自治体オープンデータのCSV（UTF-8/Shift_JIS）を列ごとに一括点検し、書き換えの優先順位と行ごとの結果CSVを出す。寝屋川市 CC BY データのサンプルつき）
- [入金消込チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nyukin-keshikomi.html): 銀行入金明細CSVと請求一覧を突き合わせ、一致・振込手数料差引・まとめ入金・一部入金・不明入金・未入金を判定（ブラウザ内処理）
- [時計の読み方プリント作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/tokei-yomi.html): analog-clock reading worksheets (on the hour/half, 5-min, 1-min), draw-the-hands and elapsed-time (minutes before/after) questions with answer pages; hour hand positioned exactly for the minutes.
- [ナンプレ（数独）プリント作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nanpure.html): 4×4/6×6/9×9 sudoku worksheets with answer pages; every puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution.
- [3割特例・簡易課税・本則課税 消費税比較](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/sanwari-tokurei.html): For Japanese sole proprietors registered for invoices: compares consumption tax under the 2-wari tokurei (2026), the new 3-wari tokurei (2027-2028), simplified taxation and the standard method.
- [支払期日60日ルール チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shiharai-kijitsu.html): Checks whether a Japanese closing/payment cycle (e.g. end-of-month close, pay end of following month) meets the 60-day payment rule of the Toriteki Act (2026, formerly Subcontract Act) and the Freelance Act; flags promissory notes, inspection-based start dates and vague wording, and computes 14.6% late interest.
- [おおきな字のバス時刻表 かこがわ](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/bus/kakogawa/): 加古川市コミュニティバス（かこバス・かこバスミニ）の次のバス3本を大きな文字・読み上げ・白黒反転で表示。GTFS-JP（CC BY 2.1 JP）から生成、bus/build_gtfs.py でほかの自治体のGTFS-JPにも流用可
- [少額減価償却資産 判定](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shoukyaku-hantei.html): For Japanese sole proprietors: sorts this year's asset purchases into under-100k full expense, 3-year lump-sum depreciation, the small-asset special rule (under 300k if acquired by 2026-03-31, under 400k from 2026-04-01, 3M yen annual cap) or straight-line depreciation, with business-use ratio.
- [印紙税額チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/inshi-check.html): Japanese revenue-stamp (印紙税) amount for paper contracts and receipts: document types 1 (real-estate transfer, loans, carriage), 2 (contracting, incl. construction), 7 (basic continuous-transaction contracts, 4,000 yen) and 17 (receipts, under 50k yen exempt), with the reduced rates for real-estate and construction contracts made by 2027-03-31, tax-exclusive judging when consumption tax is stated separately, and the rule that PDF/e-contracts need no stamp.
- [AI検索おすすめ チェックシート作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ai-suisen-check.html): For local businesses in Japan: builds a set of natural-language questions customers ask AI assistants (best X near station, service-specific, needs such as weekend hours or English support, price, comparison, brand-accuracy) in Japanese, English and Chinese, exports a CSV for recording results per assistant (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode: recommended or not, position, accuracy of description, cited sources, competitors recommended instead), and aggregates a filled CSV into recommendation share by assistant and intent, competitor counts and top cited domains.
- [ペアワイズ（オールペア）テストケース作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/pairwise.html): For game/app QA: turns factors and levels (OS, device, language, input, graphics, network) into a small test-case table covering every 2-factor combination, with forbidden-combination constraints, coverage stats and BOM CSV export. Runs in the browser.
- [対訳・用語集チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/yougo-check.html): Bilingual translation QA (Xbench-style) for any language pair: compares source/target pairs from 2-column CSV/TSV, XLIFF or TMX against a glossary and flags missing required terms (with plural matching), forbidden translations and banned spellings, inconsistent translations of the same source, number mismatches (full-width digits and thousands separators normalised), tag/placeholder mismatches ({0}, %s, <b>, XLIFF inline tags), untranslated segments and whitespace issues; CSV export. Runs in the browser.
- [日本語 校正チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kousei-check.html): Japanese proofreading checker for manuscripts, blog posts, contest entries and business email: flags redundant doubled expressions (頭痛が痛い, まず最初に, 約〜ほど), ra-nuki / re-tasu / sa-ire verb forms, double honorifics (おっしゃられる, ご覧になられる, 拝見させていただく) and part-timer keigo, misused idioms (汚名挽回, 的を得る), wordy phrases, three or more sentences with the same ending, long sentences without commas and chains of の; optional exclusion of dialogue in 「」, ignore list, and one-click replacement only for fixes with a single correct form (with conjugation). Runs in the browser.
- [英検ライティング 語数・形式チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/eiken-writing-check.html): For Eiken (STEP) English writing answers, grades 1 to 3 including Pre-2 Plus: counts words against each task's range (summary ranges specified since FY2025: 90-110, 60-70, 45-55, 25-35; e-mail and opinion-essay guidelines), flags copying from the source passage (5-word overlaps highlighted), personal opinions or examples inside a summary, contractions, full-width characters, the two questions required in the Pre-2 e-mail, and missing stance, two reasons and conclusion in the opinion essay. Runs in the browser.
- [個人事業税 チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kojin-jigyouzei.html): For Japanese sole proprietors: checks whether the prefectural individual enterprise tax applies (70 statutory business types, 5%/4%/3%), adds back the blue-return special deduction, applies the 2.9M yen owner deduction with month-based proration, white-return family-employee caps and loss carryforwards, and estimates the August/November payments. Runs in the browser.
- [景品の上限チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/keihin-jougen.html): Checks whether a Japanese prize campaign (purchase-linked lottery, everyone-gets gift, first-come freebie, joint shopping-street lottery, or purchase-free open sweepstakes) fits the Premiums and Representations Act caps: general lottery 20x transaction value or ¥100k and 2% of expected sales, joint lottery ¥300k and 3%, giveaway ¥200 or 20%; open sweepstakes have no cap since 2006.
- [未払い報酬の回収 費用計算](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/saiken-kaishu.html): For Japanese freelancers chasing unpaid invoices: compares court filing fees for small-claims suits, ordinary suits, payment demands (shiharai tokusoku) and civil mediation under the fee rules in force from 2026-05-21 (postage folded into fees, cheaper e-filing), with the court level, small-claims eligibility, a 5-year limitation date and late-interest estimate. Runs in the browser.
- [Googleビジネスプロフィール 店名・説明文 ポリシーチェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/gbp-check.html): For Japanese shops: checks a Google Business Profile business name (taglines, hours, phone/URL, station/walking-distance location text, bracketed host locations, store codes, trademark symbols, bilingual repeats) and description (750-char limit, links, discounts, prices, time-limited offers and call-to-action phrases per the October 2026 promotion policy note, keyword stuffing), lists which facts AI answers use (parking, reservations, payment, children, accessibility) are missing, computes the 4-day deadline for suggested edits, and gives a Yahoo! Place shutdown timeline (new sign-ups end 2026-11-30, service ends 2027-03-31). Runs in the browser.
- [Steam Next Fest 2027年2月 締切カレンダー＆体験版フィードバックフォーム設問メーカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nextfest.html): For indie game developers in Japan: converts the February 2027 Steam Next Fest milestones (registration closes 2027-01-10 PST, press-preview build 01-18, all items 02-01, fest 02-22 to 03-01) to Japan time with day countdowns, generates a branching demo feedback form question set in Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese, builds a Google Forms pre-filled URL that stamps the build version, and gives an in-game bug report template. Dates come from a third-party summary; confirm on Steamworks. Runs in the browser.
- [Webアクセシビリティ 簡易チェッカー＆コントラスト比・方針ページ作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/a11y-check.html): For small businesses and web freelancers in Japan: paste a page's HTML to list machine-detectable accessibility problems by JIS X 8341-3:2016 / WCAG 2.2 success criterion (missing lang/title, missing or filename-like alt, nameless links/buttons, vague 「こちら」 links, unlabeled or placeholder-only form fields, missing autocomplete, skipped headings, click-only divs, positive tabindex, zoom disabled in viewport, meta refresh, autoplay audio, videos without captions, untitled iframes, outline:none without a focus style, low inline-style contrast, no main/skip link, CAPTCHA), a manual keyboard/screen-reader checklist, a contrast-ratio calculator with a suggested passing colour, and a template for a web accessibility policy page with a 合理的配慮 contact section (配慮/一部準拠/準拠 wording). Notes that since April 2024 private businesses must provide reasonable accommodation on request while site accessibility itself is a best-effort duty. Runs in the browser; nothing is sent.
- [カスタムGPT 提供終了 移行チェッカー＆アクション→MCPサーバー変換](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/gpts-iko.html): ChatGPTのカスタムGPTは2026年12月11日に提供終了。プラグイン移行で引き継がれるもの（指示文→スキル、ナレッジ→参照ファイル、アプリ）と引き継がれないもの（カスタムアクション、モデル選択、下書き）を整理し、アクションのOpenAPIスキーマ（JSON/YAML）からStreamable HTTPのMCPサーバー（Node.js、APIキーは環境変数）を生成。移行前後の答えくらべCSVも作れる
- [AI検索に引用されやすい文章か チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/ai-inyou-check.html): For Japanese and English web writers and small businesses: paste an article or service page (Markdown, plain text or HTML) and it checks, per heading, whether single sentences still make sense when an AI answer engine (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode) quotes them alone: sentences opening with demonstratives or pronouns (これ/同社/This/It), vague words (様々な/と言われています/various/significantly), overlong sentences (80 JA chars / 35 EN words), question headings whose first sentence is a preamble instead of the answer, sections with no numbers or dates, sections that never name the business, comparison headings without a table or list, and missing update date or sources. Gives a rough 0-100 score and CSV export; states that AI citation mechanics are not public and the score guarantees nothing. Runs in the browser; nothing is sent.
- [アプリストア用スクリーンショット 多言語キャプション一括作成](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/store-shots.html): For app and game developers localizing store listings: paste a caption table (one column per language: ja, en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ko, de, ar...) and upload screenshots, and it renders captioned store screenshots for App Store sizes (iPhone 6.3" 1206x2622 required, 6.9" 1320x2868, 6.5" 1284x2778, iPad 13" 2064x2752, iPhone Duo outer 1398x2034 / inner 2007x2853, needed from April 2027 for apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK) and a Google Play 1080x1920 phone size. Auto-fits text with Japanese line-break rules and per-language CJK fonts, keeps one font size per language, flags overflowing or shrunken captions, untranslated copies, leftover placeholders ({name}, %@), RTL and Thai lines to check by eye, and exports a ZIP of JPEGs (no alpha channel) plus a CSV report. Runs in the browser; nothing is sent.
- [テスト問題 配点・正答バランス チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/test-check.html): 1問1行で合計点・番号の抜け/重複・配点や正答の空欄・選択正答の偏り/連続/規則的な並び・観点別配点割合を点検（ブラウザ内のみ・送信なし）
- [誤答パターン分析＆復習プリント設計](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/fukushu-check.html): 正答と生徒答えから符号・桁ずれ・分数・単位・選択の隣・空欄などの習慣を集計し、復習5問のテーマ案を提示（ブラウザ内のみ・送信なし）
- [通知表 所見チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shoken-check.html): クラス全員分の所見を一括点検（字数・NG表現・他児の名前の混入・似すぎた所見・学期名・文体・点数/診断名など書かない情報、ブラウザ内のみ・送信なし）
- [令和8年分 年末調整 年税額・過不足 一括計算](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/nencho-zeigaku.html): 従業員ごとの年調年税額と還付・徴収額を一括計算（令和8年12月施行の基礎控除104万円・給与所得控除最低74万円・219.1万〜220万円の特例に対応、改正前との差の目安、11月30日以前の最終給与の注意、住宅ローン控除可能額、CSV入出力、送信なし）
- [支払調書（報酬・料金）提出要否 一括判定＆e-Tax義務チェッカー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/shiharai-chosho.html): 外注先・士業・講師への1年分の支払を相手ごとに合計し、報酬・料金等の支払調書と非居住者の支払調書の提出要否を判定（5万円・50万円基準、消費税区分時は税抜判定）。令和9年1月以後の前々年30枚以上 e-Tax等義務を種類ごとに判定、CSV保存、送信なし

- [SNS投稿サイズ一括チェッカー（IG / X / TikTok / YouTube / LINE / Facebook）](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/sns-size-check.html): 推奨ピクセル一致・アスペクト比ずれ・小さすぎ・容量目安・ストーリーズ/TikTokセーフゾーン注意。画像アップロードまたは幅×高さ手入力。CSV保存。送信なし。

- [許認可の更新期限 管理台帳＆カレンダー](https://yema7582-code.github.io/koubo-ai-ok/kyoninka-kigen.html): 建設業・宅建・産廃・派遣・職業紹介・警備・旅行業などの満了日・更新申請締切・準備開始日を一覧化し .ics/CSV 出力。ブラウザ内処理。
